training.precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 disabled; FP32 CPU fallback
training.loss: Answer token plus EOS, shifted causal CE, other targets ignored; same two supervised tokens/example in both encodings.
training.length_schedule: Uniform random permutations of all 21 lengths, repeat then truncate to20k; final length counts differ by at most1.
training.batch_schedule: 64 distinct anchors sampled per update from that length; saved batch_indices.npy shared by all32 models of a unit.
training.endpoint: Fixed final20k update checkpoint; no best-checkpoint or early-stopping selection.
training.execution: Single GPU, serial jobs; no concurrent step0 creation. Resume only when protocol/data/start hashes agree.

transformer.policy: New task had no original same-task stream; reuse saved architecture-specific descents state, not seeded reconstruction

gru.policy: New task had no original same-task stream; reuse saved architecture-specific descents state, not seeded reconstruction

initialization_control: True saved original step0 per arch; new12tasks share saved descents RNG per arch, paired encodings exact; old4 retain their own original task RNG.

answer_strata: joint[n,left identity,right identity-offset,right complement-offset,right inverse-offset]; min3 per split; subtract each split stratum mean; integer offset does not change partitions
same_task_answer_strata: joint[n,own identity/complement/inverse]; min3 per split; isolated secondary comparison

metrics.neighbor_rule: Squared Euclidean; stable global anchor ordinal ties; exclude self and duplicate anchor permutations
metrics.Procrustes: fit-only PCA rank=min(8,d1,d2), fit RMS scaling, fit orthogonal; eval independently centered as frozen oracle measurement
metrics.preprocessing: fit and eval each centered independently; answer_strata keys [n,left identity,right identity/complement/inverse], min3 separately per split
metrics.undefined: NaN plus reason; no shortened-length renormalization
metrics.output_prob: numeric0..30 conditional probabilities, not full-vocab probability

cross_arch_same_task.answer_strata: joint[n,same task identity/complement/inverse] min3; differs from relation-task joint grouping, isolated secondary analysis

metric_fixture.selection: first retained rows after fixed within-length preprocessing; both controls, all phases and pairings

learning.scope: original validation and already-frozen geometry evaluation anchors; no model selection
learning.new_answer_CE: all188 vocabulary, measured on fixed original prompts
learning.EOS: old teacher-forced validation statistic only, clearly separate; no new EOS path
learning.length_mode_baseline: train-label fixed mode smallest tie; same old frozen test supplementary baseline

execution: One GPU serial missing-source jobs; exact old optimizer/batches/budget; no geometry or accuracy endpoint gate
graph_stage: Only fixed4 graph models after complete PermWorld training and analysis
dependence: One world, one initialization per arch;64models/32relation cells/8instances/21lengths/3metrics not independent; only inverse+complement types
stopping: Complete bounded PermWorld8relations and graph4tasks plus reader reports/entry/index, then stop
